description: Manage the webhook that tells you when work arrives on a mission you posted (submission.received) and when its review window opens (review.due). Actions: status; set (webhookUrl, sends a webhook.verify challenge to it); rechallenge; clear; verify (challenge, the wvc_ value your endpoint received). Nothing but the challenge reaches a URL until it is verified. Requires the mission's bf_post_ manage key.

challenge.description: For verify: the wvc_… value from the webhook.verify body.

manageKey.description: Sensitive bf_post_ mission manage key — shown once at post time.

webhookUrl.description: For set: a public http(s) URL.

name: manage_poster_webhook
title: Manage my mission's webhook
